title: The Old Cannery
note: Generated by scripts/roadside_places.py (D-138); do not edit by hand. A ruined cannery on the Valewood-Blackwater frontier road: rubble and machinery to search once, and under a trapdoor in the back office a smugglers' den whose keeper sells lockpicks and quiet tools. This variant's front, the side that faces the road, looks north; origin is the north-west corner, extending east and south.

ops.name: Silas Crane
lines: You found the hatch. Good. People who find things are my customers.
Picks, a bypass kit, a bag that doesn't rattle. Cash, no names.
The guards at either end search what they can see. I sell what they can't.
